services.name: Ash Scattering in the Bay & Memorial Cruises
services.desc: A beautiful, simple memorial ceremony on the bay honoring your loved one. Duration 2 Hours About A beautiful, simple memorial ceremony on our beautiful boat with your recorded music of choice and scattering of your loved one's cremated ashes in the wild depths of Morro Bay. 2 Hour cruise, 1 gondolier included. Permits required. Call our office for more information. Ministerial services available upon request. Live singing/music services available upon request. Ashes must be memorialized in the bay 500 yards from the shore; the availability of this cruise is HIGHLY determined by the tides. Please call our office to get available booking times.
